reproducer.runner:
(require :asdf)
(require :sb-posix)
(dolist (system '("bordeaux-threads" "ironclad" "cffi" "flexi-streams" "trivial-utf-8")) (asdf:load-system system))
(load "src/raft/package.lisp")
(load "src/raft/core.lisp")
(load "src/raft/log.lisp")
(in-package :gr8s.raft)
(let* ((root (uiop:ensure-directory-pathname (sb-posix:mkdtemp "/tmp/gr8s-config-recovery-XXXXXX")))
       (path (merge-pathnames "member.log" root))
       (storage (open-file-raft-storage path))
       (node (make-raft-node :id "one" :storage storage :current-term 1 :role :leader
                             :send-fn (lambda (&rest args) (declare (ignore args)))))
       (recovered (make-raft-node :id "one")))
  (unwind-protect
       (progn
         (raft-configure node '(("one" . :voter)))
         (raft-storage-save-hard-state storage 1 "one")
         (raft-propose node '(:raft-config :members (("one" . :voter) ("two" . :voter))))
         (assert (= 1 (raft-node-commit-index node)))
         (raft-propose node '(:raft-config :members (("one" . :voter))))
         (assert (= 1 (raft-node-commit-index node)))
         (close-file-raft-storage storage)
         (recover-raft-node recovered path)
         (format t "Recovered quorum ~D, applied ~D, commit ~D, tail ~D~%"
                 (raft-majority recovered) (raft-node-last-applied recovered)
                 (raft-node-commit-index recovered) (raft-last-log-index recovered))
         (assert (= 2 (raft-majority recovered)))
         (assert (= 1 (raft-node-last-applied recovered) (raft-node-commit-index recovered)))
         (assert (= 2 (raft-last-log-index recovered))))
    (close-file-raft-storage storage)
    (when (raft-node-storage recovered) (close-file-raft-storage (raft-node-storage recovered)))
    (uiop:delete-directory-tree root :validate t)))
